knownLimitations: General information only: not a substitute for a first aid course or professional help. This edition carries the guides in Spanish and English. Guideline editions move: a guide follows the edition cited in its header, which a later pack edition may supersede.
rights: CC BY 4.0 (NIDO guides). The cited organizations did not write or review the guides and do not endorse NIDO; their guidelines remain theirs.
sourceEdition: NIDO guides tree (knowledge-packs/nido-esencial): 58 guides per language on first aid, health at home, disasters and survival, written by NIDO following the guidelines cited in each guide (IFRC 2020; AHA CPR/ECC 2025; AHA/Red Cross First Aid 2024; WHO; CDC; Ready.gov/FEMA; NOAA; USGS; and the others listed in the pack README), as published up to October 2026.
updatePolicy: A new edition when a cited guideline changes, a guide is corrected, or a language is added. A published edition is immutable: a new edition ships under a new knowledge-packs release tag with a new line in knowledge-packs/release-ledger.json.
